newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: U.N. allocates $33 million for aid to Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: U.N. allocates $33 million for aid to Afghanistan.

text.p: The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) has allocated $33.3 million to a new peace-building programme for the needy in Afghanistan.
A UNDP statement received on Sunday said the programme would assist women, the poor, the disabled and the disadvantaged.

The poverty eradication and community empowerment (PEACE) programme will aim to increase jobs and income-generating activities, promote food security and strengthen governance at the local level to sustain community-based development.
It will also seek to reverse environmental devastation resulting from years of conflict, the statement said.
The programme was approved by representatives of 13 donor countries in Geneva last week.
The long-running conflict in Afghanistan, which has been at war since troops of the former Soviet Union invaded in 1979, has impoverished many Afghans and ruined the economy.
